content_sections.heading: KVS Ambala Cantt Posts 2026
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify the number of vacancies. The interview is being conducted to prepare a contractual panel according to the requirements of the participating schools.

rows.honorarium: Remuneration equivalent to other contractual TGTs

content_sections.heading: Desirable Qualifications
content_sections.text: Previous teaching or school work experience Knowledge of computer applications Working knowledge of English and Hindi or another Indian language Relevant practical experience for Instructor posts

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through a walk-in interview. The interview will be used to prepare a panel for part-time contractual engagement at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalayas No. 1, 2, 3 and 4, Ambala Cantt. Inclusion in the panel does not automatically guarantee an appointment. Engagement will depend on the school's requirements during the 2026-27 academic session.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates should bring the following documents to the interview venue: Completed application form One set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates Original educational qualification certificates CTET certificate for applicable TGT and Special Educator posts RCI registration and CRR details for the Special Educator post Experience certificates, where applicable Professional or sports certificates for Coach and Instructor posts Recent passport-size photographs Valid photo identity proof

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVS Ambala Cantt Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the KVS or school website. Fill in the application form completely. Prepare self-attested copies of all applicable certificates. Prepare a separate application for each post if applying for more than one position. Report to PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 2, Ambala Cantt on 25 September 2026. Complete registration between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Submit the application and attend the walk-in interview with original documents.

content_sections.heading: Walk-in Interview Venue
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 2 Ambala Cantt Haryana - 133001

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is part-time and contractual for the 2026-27 academic session. A separate application must be submitted for each post. Candidates must carry original certificates and one set of photocopies. Registration will be conducted only between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Candidates should confirm that they meet the complete subject combination and professional qualification requirements.

faq.question: Q1. When will the KVS Ambala Cantt walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the interview timing?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the registration timing?
faq.answer: Candidates must register at the venue between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 2, Ambala Cantt.

faq.question: Q5. Which teaching posts are available?
faq.answer: The teaching posts include PGT Physics, PGT Computer Science, TGT Mathematics, TGT Sanskrit and TGT Science.

faq.question: Q6. Is CTET required for TGT posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for the notified TGT posts must have qualified CTET Paper II.

faq.question: Q7. What is the honorarium for the ATL Instructor?
faq.answer: The ATL Instructor will receive Rs.25,000 per month.
